content.comment_body: Is it possible to extend the cable length between the [product_name] [article_no] controller and the operator panel? What is the maximum supported length?

Hello, According to the manual for the [product_name] [article_no] controller: You can use the included cable to connect the operator panel to the base module up to a distance of 2.5 meters. This length can be extended up to 10 meters by using a standard Sub-D cable together with the operator panel cable. Hope this clarifies your question. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user asks about cable extension limits between a controller and its operator panel to allow more flexibility during installation. Another user refers to the product manual, offering detailed distance limits and extension instructions. The core insight is the value of having clear and accessible compatibility and extension information in product documentation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward instructions and documented limitations for cable extensions to ensure reliable communication between the base controller and operator panel.
